title: Stale dependency: the study design changed beneath an unchanged conclusion (SYNTHETIC)
scientific_question: Illustrative only (invented): which synthetic site has the highest mean biomass_g among admitted plots? No real site, study or measurement is involved.
claim_tested: Given a dependency graph in which the DESIGN node study-design no longer matches its recorded SHA-256 (the admission rule changed from count >= 5 to count >= 8) while the CONCLUSION node conclusion-south-highest is byte-identical to its own recorded digest, science-gate verify with a required dependency_currency check reports FAIL with exit code 1, reason SOURCE_MISMATCH and failure modes exactly [STALE_DEPENDENCY], and its report names conclusion-south-highest and study-design as STALE_PENDING_REVALIDATION. It must not PASS because the conclusion file itself is unchanged.
falsified_by: The recorded run returning PASS, ABSTAIN or ERROR; an exit code other than 1; a reason other than SOURCE_MISMATCH; failure_modes other than exactly [STALE_DEPENDENCY]; or a report.md that lacks any of the must_mention strings.
